1.explanation:
• NumberInput/NumberInput.mdx – the main documentation for the NumberInput component, including its props, styling, and current arrow controls.
• NumberInput/migrate-to-7.x.md – migration guidance shows how controls and props have changed across versions, which is useful if the final design will introduce new control props or icon overrides.
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx – NumberInput is built on TextInput; understanding its API (including how to pass custom icons or suffix controls) is essential when swapping out the default carets for alternate controls.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows the Carbon NumberInput component: a labeled input field with the current value “50” and tiny up/down caret controls to the right of the field. The original request was to explore replacing these small carets with alternative increment/decrement controls. You can see the input’s text box, the label “Number Input label”, the gray background of the field, and the two stacked caret icons used for stepping the value.
